name: duty-ansible
description: Optional add-on for duty-framework: Ansible skill, specialist agent and the Ansible development tools MCP server (best practices, Zen of Ansible) for playbooks, roles and collections

args: docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "duty-ansible needs Docker: start Docker, then restart the session." >&2; exit 1; }; exec docker run -i --rm -v "$PWD:/workspace:ro" -e WORKSPACE_ROOT=/workspace ghcr.io/ansible/devtools-mcp-server:26.6.0 --stdio
